definition.title: Announce a new release
definition.description: Turn a changelog or release notes into posts written for X, LinkedIn, Reddit and Hacker News, plus a newsletter email for people who already follow the product, mentioning only what actually shipped. Drafts only: Tin never posts, sends or publishes them.

human_review.summary: Check that every announced change really shipped before posting or sending.

prerequisites.reason: The founder's writing style guide supplies the voice notes, so the posts sound like the founder.
The growth plan names the audience the announcements are written for.

changelog.title: What shipped in this release
changelog.description: Only this release's entries, one change per line. Take them from the repository's CHANGELOG or release notes; without those, summarize the merged commits or PRs since the last tag (git log). Leave out older releases. Nothing that is not listed here will be announced.

product_name.title: Product name
product_name.description: The name customers know it by, as on the website or README.

release_url.title: Optional link to the release
release_url.description: An https:// link to the changelog page, release notes or GitHub release. It is the only link added to the posts; leave empty when there is none.

audience.title: Who reads these announcements
audience.description: Existing users, subscribers and followers, described as in the audience section of reports/GROWTH_ONBOARDING_PLAN.md when the project has one.

tone.title: Announcement tone
tone.description: Pick the one closest to the founder's writing style guide.

voice_notes.title: Optional voice notes
voice_notes.description: A few concrete rules from the founder's style guide (.agents/skills/writing-style/SKILL.md): words to use or avoid, sentence length, emoji and hashtag habits. Paraphrase; do not paste the whole guide.

nodes.label: Sort the changelog lines
nodes.fact: one model call, code drops internal ones

nodes.label: No user-facing change
nodes.fact: the run stops, nothing is drafted

nodes.label: Write the newsletter email
nodes.fact: one model call, no invented numbers

nodes.label: Write one post per channel
nodes.fact: X, LinkedIn, Reddit, HN, lengths checked

nodes.label: Drafts ready to post
nodes.fact: you post and send them, Tin never does
